//: Every file under tools/, scripts/ and .github/ that names a kernel source root bare
(`src/kernel`, `src/kernel/`, `src/kernel/src`, not a file beneath it, or the same in
segments, `"src" / "kernel"`), with what it means by it (docs/microkernel/CRATE-SPLIT.md
S0, ledger 7346 (4), 7429 S.1). check-kernel-roots.py finds the files by grep and fails
one not listed here and an entry whose file no longer names one. `walker`: walks kernel
files, and must read the roots through kernel_roots.py (in xtask, KERNEL_PARTS_PLACE);
`boundary`: reads kernel files through check-item-boundary.py's kernel_files/kernel_path;
`whole-tree`: walks all of src/ (or src/ and tools/), so a part is in its walk by
construction (kernel_roots refuses a root outside src/); `records`: names src/kernel/src
as the base of the records keyed relative to it (rings, anchors, coverage), where a part's
file is keyed by its repo path instead; `packages`: names where the kernel's packages are;
`prose`: in comments, docstrings or messages only; `test`: test data. A `walker` or
`packages` file that reads neither kernel_roots nor KERNEL_PARTS_PLACE fails.
`parity_by`: for each walker check-kernel-roots.py does not run, how parity holds for it
(ledger 7429 S.4); a walker with neither fails.

parity_by.tools/common/check/check-build-flags.py: walks every .rs under src/ and tools/ (rust_files), and kernel_roots refuses a root outside src/; it classes kernel files by the src/kernel/ prefix and every root (KERNEL). Not run by the guard: 25 s a run, twice.
rule 4 greps src/kernel/src and every other root (kernel_roots.py others); the guard's fixture run requires rule 4 to refuse the fixture part's planted conditional (fixture_problems), under src/kernel/.
parity_by.tools/common/check/check-kernel-roots.py: the guard itself: it counts the files under the roots by git ls-files, never by a walk.
parity_by.tools/common/check/check-kernel-shape.py: walks no tree: it classes the files rustc's dep-info lists by every root (kernel_file), and its self-test holds a part's file read for ring 0 to be a breach (ledger 7429 S.2).
parity_by.tools/common/check/kernel_roots.py: the roots' reader; it walks nothing but git ls-files for the guard.
parity_by.tools/common/gen/debt-report.py: a generator writing a report: it lists every tracked .rs by git ls-files and keeps those under src/kernel/ or any root (kernel_roots.roots()), so a root is in its list by construction.
